# Tax paperwork

The declaration is due in May. Gather the annual statements from the bank, the salary certificate, the receipts for the energy renovation and the donation receipts. The online portal pre-fills most of the figures, but the rental income still has to be entered by hand.

Keep a folder with scanned copies for six years. If the final amount differs from last year by more than a fifth, check the deductions before signing. The accountant's phone number is in the address book under the letter M.

Pay the balance by direct debit to avoid the surcharge.
